fusions.name: Headlong Butt
fusions.desc: Butts the target with a gust behind the blow, dealing 14 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocking it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Over the Edge
fusions.desc: Rams a target at or below 25% health on a driving gust, dealing 22 damage and using up every affliction on it to add 1 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Planted Hooves
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% and your wind resistance by 15% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Weathered Crag
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
